insights.one_liner: US medical-device maker for sleep apnoea and breathing care; its Dutch unit is a recognised visa sponsor with a supply-chain internship in Amsterdam.

culture.text: Describes a multinational team, with internships offering mentorship and an inclusive environment.
Makes CPAP masks, machines and other products for sleep apnoea and breathing problems.
Headquartered in San Diego and listed on the New York and Australian stock exchanges; CEO is Michael Farrell.

open.text: ResMed Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its one open job here, an operations and supply chain internship in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Opened its largest advanced manufacturing plant, in Tuas, Singapore.
Targets 12-14% earnings-per-share growth, citing more sleep therapy demand from GLP-1 patients.
